article.page_convention: pdf_page is the 1-based PDF page; journal_page = pdf_page + 1116 (PDF page 1 = journal page 1117).

scope_note: This file records which original data sources the article says it used, with locators. It deliberately contains no printed results, sample sizes or other numbers from the article, and no choices of sample, items, indices, weights or exclusions.

requirements.source: Monitoring the Future (MTF), annual cross-sectional survey of U.S. high school seniors (12th grade), University of Michigan ISR
requirements.population: high school seniors (graduating classes of the survey year)

article_locators.where: abstract: nationally representative sample of U.S. high school seniors in the three survey years
Method, first paragraph: MTF data collection, multistage sampling of schools then students, school replacement, spring administration, questionnaire forms
Method, second paragraph: three data collection years, 15 years apart; 2006 described as the most recent year available when the analyses were performed

requirements.source: MTF questionnaire Form 3 respondents, each survey year
requirements.content_required: the leisure-time-and-work agree/disagree statements (work-centrality statements and a job-stability statement) and the yes/no question on whether the respondent would want to work given enough money

article_locators.where: Method: Forms 3 and 4 are the forms used; Form 3 content and response formats

requirements.source: MTF questionnaire Form 4 respondents, each survey year
requirements.content_required: the battery rating the importance of job characteristics ('Different people may look for different things in their work...')

Results, Preliminary Analyses: Form 4 items and factor structure
Table 1 (item wordings), continued on pdf pages 12-13

requirements.source: MTF design documentation cited by the article (Johnston et al., 2006; www.monitoringthefuture.org)
requirements.role: documentary description of sampling, participation and replacement procedures; not an empirical input
requirements.status: equivalent design documentation present in the supplied ICPSR codebooks and description-citation files; the cited ISR volume itself was not acquired (not an empirical input)

other_empirical_sources_needed: None identified. The article names no census, population, school-level or other external data. LISREL 8.7 (pdf page 10) is software, not a data source. Prior work cited for the factor structure (Johnson, 2000) is methodological literature, not a data input.
not_identified_in_article_text_by_source: any respondent exclusions beyond membership in Form 3 or Form 4 samples
not_identified_note: Listed only so readers and the coordinator check them independently; the source role makes no assumption about them.
